      • create

        public static Imaris.ISurfacesPrx create(ij.ImagePlus imp)
                                  throws Imaris.Error
        create a new surfaces object from this ImagePlus
        Parameters:
        imp - the image to get a surface from. Must be 8-bit and binary. It should contain a property called "Time Point" that contains the time index where this surface is to be inserted
        Returns:
        a surfaces object that should render in Imaris (though pixellated)
        Throws:
        Imaris.Error - an Imaris Error if there was a problem

      • create

        public static Imaris.ISurfacesPrx create(ij.ImagePlus imp,
                                         int timepointOffset)
                                  throws Imaris.Error
        create a new surfaces object from this ImagePlus
        Parameters:
        imp - the image to get a surface from. Must be 8-bit and binary
        timepointOffset - an index to offset the start of the surface creation. for single timepoint Images, this is effectively the timepoint at which to place the surface
        Returns:
        a surfaces object that should render in Imaris (though pixellated)
        Throws:
        Imaris.Error - an Imaris Error if there was a problem

      • find

        public static Imaris.ISurfacesPrx find(String name,
                                       Imaris.IDataContainerPrx parent)
                                throws Imaris.Error
        Get the first surfaces object with the given name You can set the public field ItemQuery.isRecursiveSearch to true if you want a recursive search
        Parameters:
        name - the name of the surfaces object to get. Returns the first surfaces object if there are multiple surfaces with the same name (Don't do that)
        parent - the parent object, a group
        Returns:
        the requested surfaces, null if not found
        Throws:
        Imaris.Error - an Imaris Error Object

      • getSurfaceIdAsMask

        public static ij.ImagePlus getSurfaceIdAsMask(Imaris.ISurfacesPrx surface,
                                              long id)
                                       throws Imaris.Error
        Allows to capture a single surface as an ImageJ binary image, within only the extents of the surface This is more computationally cheap, and can be added in place later with create(ImagePlus)
        Parameters:
        surface - the surfaces we wish to extract a single surface from
        id - the id of the surface to extract
        Returns:
        an ImagePlus mask
        Throws:
        Imaris.Error - an Imaris Error

      • getMaskDataset

        public static Imaris.IDataSetPrx getMaskDataset(Imaris.ISurfacesPrx surface)
                                         throws Imaris.Error
        Returns the Surfaces as an Imaris Dataset. The difference with the direct Imaris API here is that this includes timepoints as well.
        Parameters:
        surface - the surface to extract the dataset from
        Returns:
        a dataset of the surface mask with all timpeoints included
        Throws:
        Imaris.Error - an Imaris error

      • getMaskDataset

        public static Imaris.IDataSetPrx getMaskDataset(Imaris.ISurfacesPrx surface,
                                                double downsample,
                                                int timepoint)
                                         throws Imaris.Error
        Returns an Imaris dataset with all surfaces as a mask for the given timepoint This method ensures that the surface dataset will be the same dimensions as the original dataset
        Parameters:
        surface - the surface to extract the dataset from
        downsample - whether we want a downsampled version of the dataset (in x z and z)
        timepoint - the timepoint (0-based) whose surface we want
        Returns:
        an Imaris binary dataset, where voxels in the surface have value 1
        Throws:
        Imaris.Error - an Imaris Error
